recipe.title: High protein pasta bolognese
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Slice the mushrooms.
Brown the beef in a dry pan with the onion and garlic. Break it up well.
Add the mushrooms, crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta in salted water as the pack says. Drain.
Mix sauce and pasta and store in 4 boxes. Reheat in the microwave at work.
